Airy the Stubborn

Overview

Airy the Stubborn is Estera’s strong-willed granddaughter. Determined to be taken seriously by Zak and her grandmother, she investigates the way into the Dead City and explains how a lizard’s amulet can lead a dragon against the harpies at the observatory. Her attempt to find the magician places her in danger, and Zak’s search for her becomes part of his dealings with Shei-Var. [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]

Meeting Estera and Airy

Estera initially threatens the intruder, then changes her reception when Zak offers the Magic Bit. She dismisses the villagers’ divine-saviour story but discovers that she cannot see his past. Since Zak cannot remember it either, she suggests finding the orcs’ Magic Orb and directs him back to Erfar for information. This is the beginning of their alliance. Estera also introduces her granddaughter Airy the Stubborn, warning Zak to keep his distance; Airy resents being treated as a child. Zak’s search now has a personal aim beyond the village’s demands. [7, 8, 1, 9]

The Orb and the Dead City

When Estera uses the Orb, Zak sees an old man instead of a recognisable memory. She believes he is its owner and a more powerful magician who might help. Orc records trace the object to the Dead City. Estera distinguishes its human fortress from Gipath’s much older ruins: after the Night of Troubles, the dead attacked the living, and survivors fled to found the present village. The obvious route into the fortress is deadly. Airy leaves to investigate another way in, despite her grandmother’s objections. Separately, Erfar can send Zak into the surrounding region’s Golden Valley for a caravan’s lost treasure, an errand he badly understates. [10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16]

Airy’s route through the observatory

Airy returns with a lead to the old observatory library, but harpies occupy the site. Her plan requires a lizard’s amulet to lead a particular green dragon against them. Reaching that dragon requires Estera to freeze the lake with a green crystal. The hostile lizards on the approach present another obstacle: Zak moves the Big Shell from the Remote Mountains to the Middle Mountains, restoring the peace associated with its altar. This leaves Babur’s former quarry route unsafe and can lead to an additional errand for the craftsman. The observatory book finally supplies the password to the Dead City’s hidden entrance. Airy can also teach Zak the Magic of Feelings, only to be offended when he again calls her a little girl. [2, 3, 17, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24]

The rescue of Airy

Before leaving Gipath, Zak can finish the separate search for Airy, who set out to find the magician herself and impress him. Estera’s vision points to a goblin prison, where Zak finds her granddaughter’s potion bottle and a note leading to Shei-Var. The orc chief intends to give Airy to a frightening armoured human he calls a Demon. Zak offers to remove this threat instead. Shei-Var first demands proof of his strength against the ogre brothers, whose wealth also threatens the chief’s influence. Once Zak defeats the Demon, Shei-Var honours his promise and sends Airy home. The rescue ends with Estera’s gratitude and Airy’s distress that Zak still regards her as a child. [4, 25, 5, 26, 6, 27, 28, 29]
